notes.title: Updated Ver.1.10!!
notes.notes:
New Game Mode: Ancient Dungeon
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33175148/33bbd0917c0ad69b86c2e077312d10aec09a1a5c.png[/img]
Defeat the bosses lurking deep within the ancient dungeon!
Defeating bosses releases sealed artifacts.
New items have also been added in addition to the new game mode.
MedicalWard's effect has been changed.
WindCodex's range has been changed.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33175148/933bd64320651da1cffefe3514cd23a4c6e635b7.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33175148/3fe9589b133f133e638444dd8c09538530b55298.png[/img][/url]
Blast floor traps have been added.
Warp tiles have been added. (Warps to random location on the same floor)
Various balance changes have been made.
Fixed various bugs.
